summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports revenue of $72.7M, net loss of $35.0M, and operational metrics such as hashrate of 25.9 EH/s and BTC holdings of 1,794. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation event is described. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
